# JGA agent entry instructions

Read the single root [JGA_BOOTSTRAP.md](../JGA_BOOTSTRAP.md) and
[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). BEFORE content searches, retrieval or research, follow
[the multi-agent protocol](../docs/project/MULTI_AGENT_SCIENTIFIC_WORKFLOW_PROTOCOL.md)
and [the current coordination/embargo register](../docs/project/MULTI_AGENT_COORDINATION_STATE.md).

The register contains an active Copilot-specific independence embargo. Do not
open protected experiment contents or their summaries/derived findings. Earlier
allowed evidence remains available. No independent research or cross-review is
authorized merely by loading this repository. PI authorization governs every
new task, embargo release and scientific promotion. Follow the protocol's storage,
backup and handoff gates; do not create another bootstrap.
